data.name: Aspect of the Falcon
data.description: The falcon senses all and has the speed to hunt down even the most elusive prey. Those who take this aspect gain enhanced abilities to perceive and reconnoiter the wilderness-little escapes this shifter's attention. [Minor Form] You gain a +%1 competence bonus on Perception checks.|FeralFalconAspectPerceptionBonus
